info.name: Heal India Global API (v1)
info.description:
Every endpoint of PLAN.md section 8, grouped by module/portal.

1. Run **Auth > Demo logins > Login as ...** (or **Auth > Login** with `loginEmail`/`loginPassword`). The test script stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken`.
2. All other requests inherit Bearer `{{accessToken}}` from the collection.
3. The collection pre-request script refreshes the access token automatically shortly before it expires (POST /auth/refresh with the stored refresh token).

Create-requests store the new ids in collection variables (caseId, bookingId, orderId, ...), so the folders can be run top-to-bottom. See docs/api/README.md.

exec: // Auto-refresh: if the stored access token expires within 30 s and a refresh token is known,
// rotate it via POST /auth/refresh (mobile style: refresh_token in the body) before sending.
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: refresh }) }
// Every error uses the envelope {error: {code, message, details, request_id}} (PLAN section 3).
